primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.

For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「モアブの子ら」はアンモン人・メウニム人と共に戦いに来た人々の集団名であり、地理領域を直接指す用例ではない。

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「アンモン人とモアブ人」は、イスラエルがエジプトを出た際に侵攻を許されなかった集団を指す。

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「アンモン人・モアブ人・セイル山の人々」はユダに向かった軍勢を指す集団名。

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「アンモン人とモアブ人」はセイル山の住民に戦いを挑んだ集団として明記される。

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「モアブ人の女」はシムリテの出自を示す形容で、地理領域自体の言及ではない。

review.identityCheckJa: 2CH20:1,10,22,23の「モアブ（の子ら）」は人々・軍勢の集団名で、24:26の「モアブ人の女」は出自形容。いずれも地名としての領域を直接述べないため、場所プロフィールは採用しない。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 読者向け地名カードは作成しない。
